description.value: Small resort campsite on Moresby Island, Haida Gwaii, with four dry camping spots a short walk from the beach and full access to the on-site restaurant, nordic sauna, golf course, and pickleball courts. Reaching the island requires a BC Ferries connection from Prince Rupert or a flight into Sandspit Airport, making this a true edge-of-the-world stop.
